sources_used.source: Google Maps (browser) - hvac contractor North Brunswick NJ
iBegin North Brunswick business directory (category pages)
Loc8NearMe - North Brunswick city index (towing, recent listings)
Hadaa - NJ DCA home-improvement registration index, landscapers North Brunswick (p.1-2)
BestProsInTown - North Brunswick plumbers / home cleaning
Carwise - North Brunswick auto body shops
NJ Board of Tree Experts business directory
Web search (openai provider) for each trade category + North Brunswick NJ

categories_thin: Pools: only three pool companies surfaced (Lampsi, S&R Pool & Spa, Best Pool Solutions) and two are Angi service-area listings without local addresses - BBB and Angi pool pages were blocked.
Security installers: only four local firms found (AFA, Accurate International Tech, Pro-Tec, BGS); most alarm work in the area is done by ADT/regional dealers, which are excluded as chains.

Moving and storage: very thin - one mover based in the zone (Jersey Moving Pro) plus two small storage operators; Two Men and a Truck, U-Haul, Public Storage and Mini U are brand/franchise and excluded.

Restoration / water damage: the firms advertising here are regional (SERVPRO franchise excluded, Northeast Power Dry and similar run service-area pages only), so local independent restoration shops may be undercounted.
Garage doors: only two listings, both at the same multi-tenant address and both looking like lead-generation marketing rather than shops.
Siding/windows specialists: mostly service-area pages from firms based elsewhere; only A.W. Hobor & Sons looks locally based.

General contractors: many iBegin entries are home-office/owner-operator addresses with no web presence; a modern licensed-contractor roster for the township was not available (state lookup requires interactive verification).
caveats: iBegin listings are numerous and give street addresses and phones, but that directory's data can be years old; several shops appear under former names (e.g. Ben's Auto/High Velocity, Kingsborn/Oil Express, Kon Tai/Raj Auto). Treat iBegin-only entries as leads to confirm.

The Hadaa landscaper list is derived from NJ DCA home-improvement contractor registrations by municipality, not from a business directory; roughly half carry expired registrations and many are one-person operations with no address or website published.
A cluster of firms share 2227 US-1 (CCS Mechanical, Above All Roofing, Johnny Locksmith, Aspenn Tree Care), which looks like a mailbox/virtual-office address rather than a real shop location.

Excluded as chains/franchises although present in North Brunswick: Malouf Chevrolet/Cadillac, Malouf Ford/Lincoln, DCH Brunswick Toyota, Midas, Pep Boys, Goodyear, AutoZone, Maaco, Caliber Collision, Roto-Rooter, KeyMe, Minute Key, PGW Auto Glass, Public Storage, U-Haul, Mini U Storage, Two Men and a Truck, Stanley Steemer, SERVPRO, ServiceMaster, College HUNKS.
Several entries have no street address because the source directory published only a phone or the firm is mobile/service-area; those are marked Unknown so the triage team can resolve them.
data_gaps: BBB (bbb.org) returned HTTP 403 on every category and profile page; BBB business names appeared only through search snippets.
Angi, YellowPages, Superpages, Cylex, AllPages, find-open, firmania and localitybiz all returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches; their content was used only as search-result snippets.
Google Maps worked once (HVAC query, 5 results) then served a 'systems have detected unusual traffic' bot check; no bypass attempted, so Maps was not used for the remaining ~20 categories.
Overpass API / OpenStreetMap returned HTTP 400 for a bbox query and was not pursued further.
North Brunswick Township's own site was not searched for a licensed-business or economic-development directory; no municipal contractor roster was obtained.
Middlesex County Regional Chamber of Commerce member directory was not retrievable in this session.
Phone numbers and addresses for entries sourced only from iBegin or Angi listings were not independently confirmed against a second source.
